lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Debt securities
lines.why: Bonds held for sale or to maturity: financial.

lines.name: Equity securities
lines.why: Shares held for their return: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: The Parent has no significant business operations of its own and relies on fees, dividends and other distributions from its operating subsidiaries as the principal source of cash flow to meet its obligations.
Policy premiums depend on several factors, including but not limited to issue age, level of coverage and any selected riders or options.
Options depend on job responsibilities and may include flexible work schedules, paid time off, paid holidays and part-time employment.
The Company’s operations rely on the secure processing, storage, and transmission of confidential and personal identifiable information within various technology platforms.

The declaration and payment of dividends is at the discretion of the Company’s board of directors and will depend upon the financial condition, capital requirements, and earnings of the Company, as well as any restrictions contained in any agreements by which the Company is bound and other factors as the board of directors may deem relevant.

The Company’s primary sources of cash are written premiums, investment income and proceeds from the sale and maturity of its invested assets, as well as borrowings from time to time under our revolving credit facility.
